review_plan.claim_under_review: The v2 contract's own claims as it will state them: (i) Stage 0's a-scan locates whether any (a, r) admits a feasible T_sel operating point (ORACLE(T_sel) eps_ss >= STATIC(T) eps_ss), and the ordering rho_ORACLE(a=1/4) < rho_ORACLE(a=1/2) holds; (ii) at every interpreted cell, G3 correctly gates S1/F1 as UNTESTABLE rather than negative when infeasible; (iii) the corrected HEUR-BLT-7 (admitted-walk count) tracks the measured r_eff better than v1's k=4 formula; (iv) the per-admission pool cap keeps CAP(2T)'s S_peak at 2T (not 2.6-2.8T as in v1); (v) the permanent negative fixture (the two red-team bijection seed sets) scores G1 FAIL, never a crash, on every run; (vi) any S1_v2 pass or fail is reported as the full frontier tuple (T_sel/T, S_peak/T, P/sqrt(NT), L, eps_ss, eps_cum, U, early_penalty), never a bare ratio.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Item (h)'s a-scan is a REPLICATION of a quantity aed829/the BATCH-289698 obstruction already measured at a=1/4 (oracle floor ~0.55) and a=1/2 (~0.67, from the red team's F-J4-3 finding); the prior is that the a-scan will reproduce this same ordering rather than surface a new feasible point, and that G3 will therefore fire UNTESTABLE at every T_sel in {0.65T, 0.75T} at a=1/4 (since even T/2's ceiling was infeasible there, a LARGER T_sel is closer to feasible but the decision's own next_actions do not claim it clears the bar). The most likely failure mode is a bookkeeping defect in the NEW machinery itself (G3's exact-vs-sampled boundary at 2^30, the corrected HEUR-BLT-7 admitted-walk count estimator, or the per-admission cap enforcement) rather than a genuine positive result on the original claim. The coordinator does NOT expect S1_v2 to pass at a=1/4 on this grid; a pass there is the record's most informative possible outcome and must be scrutinized hardest.

joints.joint: G3 ceiling-feasibility gate correctness: at every (a, r, T_sel) cell, G3 must read the SAME exact top-T_sel share / STATIC(T) coverage comparison an independent re-enumeration would give, and must correctly emit UNTESTABLE (never a negative S1/F1 verdict) on failure.
joints.attack_plan: Independently re-enumerate exact basins at N=2^24 for at least 2 of the tested (a, r) cells and recompute the top-T_sel share vs STATIC(T)'s exact coverage from scratch (own code, not reading the executor's G3 implementation first). Compare your number to the run's G3 verdict. Separately, read the executor's G3 code and confirm the UNTESTABLE branch is actually reachable and taken (not silently falling through to a default PASS).
joints.breaking_artifact: A cell where your independent G3 reading disagrees with the run's recorded G3 verdict, or where a G3 FAIL cell nonetheless reports an S1/F1 verdict instead of UNTESTABLE.

joints.joint: Blind re-derivation of the Stage 0 a-scan's headline ordering claim: rho_ORACLE(a=1/4, r) vs rho_ORACLE(a=1/2, r) at N=2^20, for the r values the contract tests.
joints.attack_plan: SEAL a re-derivation of rho_ORACLE at a in {1/4, 1/2} and the tested r values, from the exact basin definitions alone (as in the BATCH-289698 J2 protocol: write and sha256/timestamp the sealed result BEFORE opening any of the executor's Stage 0 code, run files, or the v2 spec's own worked formula), then compare. This is a blind re-derivation, not a rerun of the pipeline.
joints.breaking_artifact: Your sealed independent computation disagrees with the run's Stage 0 ordering result beyond CI, or the ordering itself is reversed from the BATCH-289698 finding it is meant to reproduce (0.55 at a=1/4 vs 0.67 at a=1/2).

joints.joint: Per-admission pool cap and working-storage accounting: does CAP(2T)'s measured S_peak actually equal 2T (not drift to 2.6-2.8T as in v1), and is every headline number reported as the full frontier tuple with S_peak charged, never a bare ratio?
joints.attack_plan: Read the executor's pool-admission code and manually trace at least one full round of admission-then-cap on a small synthetic example to confirm truncation happens immediately after each admitted target, not once at round end (the v1 defect the amendment fixes). Then grep every reported headline number in the execution report and analysis outputs for a bare T_sel/T or rho ratio not accompanied by its S_peak/T sibling; a bare ratio anywhere is a finding.
joints.breaking_artifact: Any CAP(2T) cell whose measured S_peak exceeds 2T by more than rounding, or any headline number reported without its frontier-tuple siblings.

joints.joint: Proves-too-much: the permanent negative fixture (the two red-team bijection seed sets under TASK-20260906-90e7cf/{src/pipeline_perm,results/j4_perm}) and the corrected HEUR-BLT-7 on a null object.
joints.attack_plan: Run (or confirm the executor ran) the v2 pipeline against both permanent-negative-fixture objects and verify G1 reports FAIL on both, with no exception raised (the v1 defect item g fixes). Separately, construct or reuse a random-permutation null object (no tree structure, basins of size 1) and confirm the corrected HEUR-BLT-7 and the frontier-tuple pipeline report nothing resembling a positive re-selection gain on it -- the mechanism should collapse exactly as cf3b76 predicted for basins of size 1.
joints.breaking_artifact: G1 does not FAIL on both permanent-fixture seed sets (a crash counts as failing this check, per item g's own requirement that it FAIL, never crash), or the pipeline reports a nonzero re-selection gain on the permutation null.
